adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure in `handleAdd`, but it is only reset in the Cancel button handler. The `onSuccess` callback closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue`, but does not reset `isInvalidEmail`, so reopening after a successful add can show a stale error banner. Also, closing via `Dialog`’s `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` (ESC/overlay) does not reset `isInvalidEmail` (or `multiEmailValue`), so reopening after an invalid attempt will still show the error state over a fresh open.
